title: ALWAYS: ILL
description:
ABOUT ALWAYSALWAYS: ILL is a psychological horror experience that plunges you into a world where memories lie, shadows breathe, and every step draws you deeper into a reality you can no longer trust. You play as a man shattered by loss, desperately searching for his missing daughter in the aftermath of a mysterious catastrophe. As you explore abandoned towns, decaying homes, and twisted dreamscapes, the line between the living and the dead begins to blur.

What begins as a search turns into a descent—into madness, into grief, into a hidden world governed by a dark ritual and a forbidden pact. Something ancient is watching. Something that feeds on pain… and wants you to remember.

Navigate eerie environments, solve emotional and environmental puzzles, and survive chilling encounters in a game that fuses cinematic storytelling with terrifying gameplay. But be warned: in ALWAYS, it's not just what’s in front of you that you should fear—it’s what’s been buried deep within.

ALWAYS: ILL GAME LORE

After losing his daughter, a broken detective clings to the sound of her voice — until an accident pulls him into a twisted nightmare. Trapped in haunting echoes of her past, he must solve puzzles and uncover chilling clues to stop a deranged man from sacrificing his child... to bring back his own.

ALWAYS: ILL GAME FEATURES

• Unique, Smart Puzzles

Solve a variety of logic-based and environmental puzzles that challenge your perception.

• Psychological Horror Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in a disturbing world where reality shifts constantly and every location tells a piece of a deeper, darker truth.

• Cinematic Storytelling

Experience a haunting narrative focused on a father’s emotional journey to find his daughter, with professionally crafted cutscenes and in-game storytelling moments.

• First-Person Immersion

Explore detailed, atmospheric environments from a first-person perspective that enhances tension, discovery, and dread.

• Quick-Time Survival Events (QTEs)

Engage in intense, heart-pounding moments where quick reflexes are the difference between life and death.

• Emotion-Driven Exploration

Every location, item, and puzzle is tied to the character’s emotional past, making exploration meaningful and impactful.

• Dynamic Sound Design

Designed to keep you on edge, with subtle audio cues, whispers, footsteps, and unsettling ambiance following your every move.
